Filename : devices.txt
Datetime : 2026-11-13 13:38:21 +0000

------
router
* Network device that forwards packets between different networks using IP addresses
* Device that keeps a table of routes to choose where each packet goes next

+-------------------+-----------------------------------------+
| attribute         | value                                   |
+-------------------+-----------------------------------------+
| OSI layer         | Network layer                           |
| Addresses it uses | IP addresses                            |
| Typical place     | Between a home network and the internet |
| Main table        | Routing table                           |
+-------------------+-----------------------------------------+
+--------------------------------------+
| Steps to forward a packet            |
+--------------------------------------+
| Receive the packet                   |
| Read the destination address         |
| Look up the routing table            |
| Send it through the chosen interface |
+--------------------------------------+
------
switch
* Network device that connects devices in the same network and sends each frame only to the port where its destination is

+-------------------+--------------------------+
| attribute         | value                    |
+-------------------+--------------------------+
| OSI layer         | Data link layer          |
| Addresses it uses | MAC addresses            |
| Typical place     | Inside an office network |
| Main table        | MAC address table        |
+-------------------+--------------------------+
+------------------+
| commands         |
+------------------+
| show interface 1 |
| show interface 2 |
| show interface 3 |
+------------------+
---
hub
* Old network device that repeats every signal it receives to all its ports

+----------------------+
| features             |
+----------------------+
| Repeats signals      |
| Shares bandwidth     |
| Has no address table |
+----------------------+
--------
firewall
* Device or program that allows or blocks network traffic following a set of rules
